headline: President Obama created an advisory group called the President's Global Development Council.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a council called the President's Global Development Council. Based on the title, the group's role relates to global development, meaning US efforts to help other countries grow and reduce poverty. No summary was provided, so details about who sits on the council and exactly what it does are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies involved in foreign aid and international development
who_it_affects.how: They may receive advice or input from the new council on global development matters.
